3. **Nit** (`correctness`) — [`docs/linting.md:42`](docs/linting.md): Prose still says local `make -j10 test-harnesses` after the doc was updated elsewhere to eleven matrix shards. **Scenario:** Readers following the doc for maximum local parallelism may under-parallelize (one shard never starts in the first wave). **Fix:** Update to `-j11` or rephrase to “one job per shard” without a stale number.
